successCriteria.description: The Employee module barrel (`src/modules/employee/index.ts`) re-exports the Employee entity interface, IEmployeeRepository, EmployeeRepository, IEmployeeService, and EmployeeService — and all five compile without type errors under strict TypeScript.

The LeavePolicy module barrel (`src/modules/leave-policy/index.ts`) re-exports the LeavePolicy entity interface, ILeavePolicyRepository, LeavePolicyRepository, ILeavePolicyService, and LeavePolicyService — and all five compile without type errors under strict TypeScript.

IEmployeeRepository extends IBaseRepository<Employee> and declares findByEmployeeNumber(employeeNumber: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByManagerId(managerId: string): Promise<Employee[]>, and findActive(): Promise<Employee[]>.
ILeavePolicyRepository extends IBaseRepository<LeavePolicy> and declares findByLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy | null> and findActive(): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>.

IEmployeeService declares getById(id: string): Promise<Employee | null>, getByEmployeeNumber(employeeNumber: string): Promise<Employee | null>, getByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>, getSubordinates(managerId: string): Promise<Employee[]>, and isActive(id: string): Promise<boolean>.

ILeavePolicyService declares getById(id: string): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>, getByLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>, getActivePolicies(): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>, and isLeaveTypeActive(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<boolean>.
EmployeeService.getSubordinates returns only employees whose managerId matches the given id AND whose employmentStatus is ACTIVE.
EmployeeService.isActive returns true when the employee exists and employmentStatus === EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE; returns false when the employee does not exist or is not ACTIVE (never throws).
LeavePolicyService.isLeaveTypeActive returns true when an active policy exists for the given LeaveType; returns false when no active policy exists for that type (never throws).

Both unit test files (`tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.service.spec.ts` and `tests/unit/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.service.spec.ts`) exist, pass with Jest, and mock the repository layer — no real database connection is required.

constraints: All database access MUST go through the repository layer — EmployeeService and LeavePolicyService MUST NOT import or use the pg Pool directly; they delegate to IEmployeeRepository / ILeavePolicyRepository exclusively.
